entries.acb1bdd3603d7194: Because project staff handle everything from procurement through development to sales, the company has a structure that allows quick decision-making and agile execution of operations. As examples of project development that plans added services suited to each site, it cites residences that introduced personal training and breakfast services, and a medical mall that gathers clinics in front of a station in a residential area.

entries.dabb9aae1c328d7c: Under its corporate philosophy, 'Creating a stage on which people shine for the world', its basic concept is 'Hard' × 'Service', and its basic policy is to provide, in an integrated manner, everything from planning to operating services that reflect the needs of residents and tenants using the buildings. Its management is based on awareness of strengthening net assets on the balance sheet, and it is promoting a wider range of development methods, including methods that use external capital as well as its own funds and the development of BTS (Build To Suit) facilities that reflect tenant demand. In the medium to long term, in addition to expanding its real estate leasing management service, it intends to use development projects as a pipeline through its asset management service, securing continuing earnings opportunities and stabilizing its business portfolio.
